title: The message time check reads the bracket stamp form
why: Incident 13:13-13:14 CST Nov 12: the retrospective's four messages stamped 13:16 and 13:19 CST were sent at 13:13-13:14 CST; it wrote the times without reading the clock (rule building-mistake-names-its-guard).
note: Guard message-time-matches-clock let them through: its header pattern (hooks/guard_merge.py _STAMP_HEADER) needs a comma, colon or dash after the sender words, and the bracket form "[consultant 13:19 CST]" has none. The coordinator uses the same form, so every bracket stamp goes unchecked. Fix: the pattern accepts a leading "[<words> HH:MM CST]". Red first on "[consultant 13:19 CST] x" at 13:14. Same family as step stamp-guard-send-message (lane session_013NEJL2w2TGYjZFexEa6uyw): fold in if that lane takes it. Folded 13:18 CST Nov 12 into lane stamp-guard-send-message (coordinator).
